Heritage desk

What is happening across India's past and living heritage

Seven fields, one desk: archaeology, linguistics, anthropology, the arts, Sanskrit, history and heritage. New finds, research, exhibitions and performances, conferences, jobs and calls, and decisions on sites. Written in our own words, with the sources under every story.

Finds and excavations

  1. 10 November 2026 · History · Linguistics and scripts

    Pillar inscription from the reign of Chalukya king Vikramaditya VI read at Kothakota, Telangana

    A heritage research group says a three-sided Kannada inscription on a temple pillar in Wanaparthy district records land gifts made in the early 12th century, under the Kalyana Chalukya ruler Vikramaditya VI.

    Where: Kothakota, Wanaparthy district, Telangana

  2. 8 November 2026 · Archaeology

    State dig in Nagapattinam recovers Chola-period bronzes of Nataraja and Sivakami

    Tamil Nadu's archaeology department has found two bronze images, of Nataraja and the goddess Sivakami, about a metre below ground at an excavation in Nagapattinam district. Experts provisionally date them to the 12th century.

    Where: Nagapattinam district, Tamil Nadu

Research and publications

  1. 12 November 2026 · Anthropology · History

    New study: de-notified tribes remain uncounted and over-policed seven decades after the Criminal Tribes Act was repealed

    A paper by two University of Delhi law researchers argues that the 1952 repeal changed the label, not the machinery, and asks for these communities to be counted in the 2027 Census.

Museums and exhibitions

  1. 12 November 2026 · Arts, crafts and performance

    Second Bengal Biennale, 'Banalata', opens in Santiniketan on 25 November and Kolkata on 28 November

    The multi-venue art biennale returns for a second edition, curated by the Chander Haat collective and Ritika Biswas around Jibanananda Das's poem Banalata Sen. It runs until 2 January 2027.

    When: 25 November 2026 to 2 January 2027 · Where: Santiniketan and Kolkata, West Bengal

Conferences, lectures and seminars

  1. 13 November 2026 · Arts, crafts and performance · Anthropology · Heritage, museums and conservation

    Nagaland's 27th Hornbill Festival runs at Kisama from 1 to 10 December

    The state's yearly showcase of Naga tribal heritage opens on Statehood Day at the Naga Heritage Village, alongside a ten-day music festival that, the Chief Minister's adviser says, will favour local talent.

    When: 1 December 2026 to 10 December 2026 · Where: Naga Heritage Village, Kisama, near Kohima, Nagaland

  2. 12 November 2026 · Arts, crafts and performance

    Serendipity Arts Festival returns to Panjim from 13 to 20 December, free to attend

    The 11th edition of the multidisciplinary festival in Goa covers visual arts, craft, music, dance, theatre and food, each strand led by named curators.

    When: 13 December 2026 to 20 December 2026 · Where: Panjim, Goa

  3. 12 November 2026 · Sanskrit and classical texts · Linguistics and scripts

    Deccan College, Pune, hosts the 9th International Sanskrit Computational Linguistics Symposium in January

    Researchers working on computers and Sanskrit, Prakrit and Pali meet in Pune from 20 to 22 January 2027. The call for papers has closed.

    When: 20 January 2027 to 22 January 2027 · Where: Deccan College, Pune

  4. 11 November 2026 · History

    Spalding Symposium on Indian Religions extends its 2027 call for papers to 20 November

    The 52nd symposium meets in Cambridge from 2 to 4 April 2027 on the theme of making, mapping and maintaining the world. Proposals are now due by 20 November 2026.

    When: 2 April 2027 to 4 April 2027 · Where: Selwyn College and Faculty of Divinity, University of Cambridge, UK · Apply by: 20 November 2026

  5. 5 November 2026 · History

    Indian History Congress moves its 85th session to Puducherry, February 2027

    The annual meeting of Indian historians will not take place in Bengaluru in December. It now runs from 26 to 28 February 2027 at Tagore Government Arts and Science College, and papers are due by 7 February.

    When: 26 February 2027 to 28 February 2027 · Where: Tagore Government Arts and Science College, Puducherry · Apply by: 7 February 2027

Jobs, fellowships, courses and calls

  1. 11 November 2026 · Linguistics and scripts

    Uppsala University seeks a permanent senior lecturer in Hindi

    The full-time post in the Department of Linguistics and Philology centres on teaching Hindi to undergraduates. Applications close on 11 January 2027.

    Where: Uppsala, Sweden · Apply by: 11 January 2027

  2. 9 November 2026 · Anthropology · Arts, crafts and performance

    Jagiellonian University seeks a postdoctoral researcher for its South Indian song cultures project

    The two-year research post in Kraków belongs to VOICES, a European Research Council project on the pattu song traditions of South India. Applications close on 21 November 2026.

    Where: Kraków, Poland · Apply by: 21 November 2026

  3. 7 November 2026 · History

    American Institute of Indian Studies fellowships for research in India close on 19 November

    AIIS is taking applications for three fellowships that fund research trips to India: one for doctoral students, one for senior scholars and one for early-career scholars. The deadline is 19 November 2026.

    Apply by: 19 November 2026

  4. 6 November 2026 · Archaeology

    Sagar university seeks a contract curator for its archaeology department

    Dr Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya is offering one curator post at Rs 40,000 a month, on a contract of up to 12 months. Online applications close on 30 November 2026.

    Where: Sagar, Madhya Pradesh · Apply by: 30 November 2026

  5. 6 November 2026 · History

    Rice University advertises its endowed professorship in Jain Studies

    The Tirthankar Shantinath Professorship in Houston is open at assistant level, with associate level and tenure possible for qualified candidates. Materials should arrive by 15 November 2026 for fullest consideration.

    Where: Houston, Texas, USA · Apply by: 15 November 2026

  6. 5 November 2026 · History · Linguistics and scripts

    University of Zurich seeks a professor of the cultural history of India

    The open-rank post, described as premodern Indology with the specialisation left open, is at the Institute of Asian and Oriental Studies. It starts on 1 August 2028 and closes to applications on 7 December 2026.

    Where: Zurich, Switzerland · Apply by: 7 December 2026

Sites, policy and conservation

  1. 12 November 2026 · Heritage, museums and conservation · Linguistics and scripts

    Visva-Bharati begins digitising the manuscripts of its Lipika collection under Gyan Bharatam

    The university in Santiniketan says work has started on thousands of rare manuscripts in Sanskrit, Bengali, Odia, Tamil and other languages, as part of the Ministry of Culture's national manuscript mission.

    Where: Santiniketan, West Bengal

  2. 12 November 2026 · Sanskrit and classical texts · Heritage, museums and conservation · History

    Manuscripts of the Mahabharata, Rajatarangini and Arthashastra join UNESCO's Asia-Pacific memory register

    Three Sanskrit manuscripts held in Pune, Mysuru and Srinagar were inscribed on UNESCO's Memory of the World Asia-Pacific Regional Register at a meeting in Jakarta, taking India's entries on that register to six.

    Where: Pune, Mysuru and Srinagar

  3. 12 November 2026 · Heritage, museums and conservation · History

    Cabinet approves Rs 3,230 crore plan to turn North and South Block into the Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum

    The approval on 11 November gives the museum a budget and a timetable: implementation in phases to 2030-31, with a first gallery, on adornment, due to open in North Block in the latter part of 2027.

    Where: New Delhi

  4. 8 November 2026 · Heritage, museums and conservation · Arts, crafts and performance

    Ministry of Culture signs agreement with Google Arts & Culture to put heritage collections online

    The memorandum covers ASI monuments, national museum holdings, manuscripts documented under Gyan Bharatam and living traditions, with the Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum at its centre.

    Where: New Delhi
